start: AI Assistant open, the owner has credits; some members have the app, some do not

steps.action: Ask "Tell everyone the gym is closed on Sunday"
user_sees: A card "Message to your members"
Who gets it: "Everyone · {n} members" and "{n} have the app"
Type "Gym closed", the day with its date in words
Language: English / Hindi / Both
The message words
must_not: A closure message with no day
The closure day used as the send time
Archived members counted
Anything sent yet

steps.action: Change a few words in the message
user_sees: The words as typed
must_not: A later rewrite throws the typed words away without a word

steps.action: Tap the send button ("Send now · 1 credit")
user_sees: The button shows it is busy
A done line: "Sent to {n} in the app." and, when some have no app, how many are ready on WhatsApp
Credits one lower
must_not: Two messages from a double tap
A credit taken with nothing sent
A WhatsApp sent by itself

steps.action: Open the WhatsApp list from the done card and send to one member
user_sees: A list of members without the app, one tap a person, in the owner's own WhatsApp
must_not: One member twice for one number
A member who has the app on the WhatsApp list

start: A message card in English is open

steps.action: Tap "Hindi" (or "Both")
user_sees: The send button waits and says the Hindi is being written
Then the Hindi words show and the Hindi chip is on
must_not: The chip moves before the Hindi words are there
The message can be sent in English while Hindi is chosen
A credit used for the Hindi

steps.action: Tap "Shorter", then "Add Hindi"
user_sees: New words each time; the send button comes into view
must_not: Dates, prices or names changed by the rewrite
Endless rewrites with no word when the limit is reached

steps.action: The Hindi could not be written (no internet)
user_sees: A line where the owner tapped that the Hindi was not written, with a button to try again
must_not: "Try again" with no button
The chip left on Hindi

steps.action: Ask "Send a Diwali greeting to everyone tomorrow at 8 am"
user_sees: The card with the day and time; the button says the day and time it goes, not "Send now"
must_not: The message goes at once
A time in the past accepted

steps.action: Send
user_sees: A done line that it will go at that time; 1 credit
must_not: The message never goes
It goes twice

steps.action: Ask "Send a renewal reminder to Asha and Rahul"
user_sees: Who gets it: "2 members"; a "Which one?" step when a name fits several
must_not: The message goes to everyone
A name not found is skipped silently

start: A "Fees due" answer card is on screen

steps.action: Tap "Send them a fee reminder"
user_sees: A message card for the members who owe: "{n} members", "{n} have the app"
must_not: A member who paid today on the list
The amount of one member shown to another

steps.action: Send
user_sees: Sent in the app; the rest ready on WhatsApp
must_not: A reminder to a member who owes nothing

steps.action: Ask for a message to "the Zumba batch" when no such batch exists
user_sees: "This group could not be found." and the send is stopped
must_not: The message drafted for everyone

steps.action: Clear the message words and tap send
user_sees: "Write the message."
must_not: An empty message sent
A credit taken

steps.action: Send with 0 credits
user_sees: "You have no AI credits left. Ask MettleUp for credits to send this." and the credits sheet
must_not: The message sent
The draft lost

steps.action: Send while the app-member list could not load
user_sees: "The app list could not load." and a clear word on what will happen
must_not: A done line with a wrong count

start: A message card is open and not sent

steps.action: Tap "Cancel"
user_sees: "Cancelled. Nothing was sent or saved, and no credit was used."
must_not: A message sent
A credit used

steps.action: Ask again, send it, then tap send again or reload and repeat
user_sees: "This was done already."
must_not: A second message to members
A second credit

steps.action: Send a third message on the same day
user_sees: A warning that this is the third message today; send still works
must_not: No warning
The send blocked with no reason

start: The owner sends a message to a group

steps.action: Send a fee reminder to members who owe
user_sees: Only those members get it
must_not: A member outside the group gets it
Members of another branch or gym get it
The list of who owes is sent to the AI

steps.action: Look at who can see it
user_sees: The member sees it in the app inbox; members without the app only if the owner sends the WhatsApp himself
must_not: A WhatsApp sent from MettleUp's number without the owner's tap
A phone number shown to another member
